verified.claim: stylus/offchain-prices.json holds the Rust pricer's answers computed off-chain (the program is not deployed): all 10,001 values reproduce, and the /agent section that shows them is labelled off-chain and true
verified.evidence: Re-checked by an independent re-verifier at 2026-10-04T02:22:36Z. (a) Rebuild: in a copy of stylus/ in my temp dir (stylus/target untouched), cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --locked gives a wasm byte-identical to the main session's (47,988 bytes, same sha256). cargo stylus get-initcode run in /Users/naitik/surety/stylus itself, with CARGO_TARGET_DIR in my temp dir: project metadata hash 207062f8...42ab8, program 13,819 bytes, initcode 13,862 bytes, codehash keccak256(program) = 0x063026be3176d38d9a5f1dca4d2c9e829918371b4430f6abb98bb1a5b3fdaaec, as recorded. The JSON's initcodeSha256 3981fb0e... is the sha256 of the initcode hex text without 0x (of the raw bytes it is bbdc06ce...). From the copy at another path get-initcode gives a different codehash (0x0c6eda7b17147058dc4d991e15b76f299b37275f738fd1cf5cded6fe8be5c055): cargo-stylus embeds a path-dependent project_hash custom section (45 bytes), and every code and data section is identical between the two builds, so the codehash is reproducible only at that path. (b) Rerun: stylus/scripts/offchain-prices.ts in a scratch copy with my own initcode and --expect-codehash wrote 10,001 quotes, TypeScript matches 10001/10001, and the JSON is identical to stylus/offchain-prices.json except generatedAt; with the copy-built initcode and the same --expect-codehash it refuses (exit 1, no file). (c) Independent values: my own Python model of docs/PRICING.md (exact normal CDF via erfc, half up to bps x 1e4) equals all 10,001 entries (0 differ); shared/src/pricing.ts equals all 10,001; the 8 rows of stylus/vectors.json with the same inputs (w = 1, 100, 1000, 3000, 4000, 7000, 8000, 10000) all equal the table; the 2 PRICING_VECTORS with the same inputs give 13.093262 and 174.736095 bps against the table's 13.0933 and 174.7361; my own runner (not program.mjs) on my in-place program equals the table on 400 of 400 sampled w; wasm-check on that program 16,071 of 16,071 vectors; cargo test --lib --release: 7 passed. (d) Inputs: sigmaBps 5457 (TSLA, 0.5457), 30 days, limit 1000, cap 3000 equal what /agent derives: shared/src/records/index.json gives sigma 0.5457, limit 1000, term 30, rulesMax 0.3 (Careful) and 0.8 (Bold), so StylusPrice.tsx rounds to sigmaBps 5457 and w = 3000 and 8000 (Math.round(x * 10000) has no float trap here) and CAP_BPS 3000; the table's 13.0933 and 174.7361 bps equal the records' worstCaseBps 13.0933 and 174.7361. (e) Preview with a scratch BONDLINE_REPO_ROOT on port 3108 (server stopped afterwards) whose B.json carries this needle: both /agent pages show 'Same model, in Rust' with the pill 'Rust · Stylus · off-chain', 'Stylus activations are paused on Robinhood Chain (ArbWasm reports an activation cost of 2^64 − 1), so the pricer isn't deployed ... computed off-chain', the rows 'TypeScript (this site)' and 'Rust (Stylus program, off-chain)' at 13.0933 and 174.7361 bps, and 'Program codehash 0x063026be…fdaaec. ... all 10,001 stock shares ... Not an on-chain call'; no console errors and no horizontal overflow at 375 and 1440 px. The section is hidden with the real B.json (no needle), with B 'fail', with a table computed for other inputs (sigmaBps 5456), and in 28 of 28 unit checks of readOffchainPrices and offchainFair (a 10,000-entry table, typescriptCheck mismatch, missing fields, a missing or unparseable file, w = 10001, w = -1, a non-integer w, NaN, other sigma, term, limit or cap all give null); wording about the program being deployed does not unlock it. The facts in the copy hold: ArbWasm.activationGas() = 18446744073709551615 (2^64 - 1) on testnet (cast call) and mainnet, and cargo stylus check --endpoint testnet (read-only) prints 'Stylus activations appear to be paused on this chain (activation gas charge is 18446744073709551615)'. Minor wording points, none changes a number: under the off-chain rows the footnote says 'Difference 0.0000 bps (the contract's rounding to 0.0001 bps)', which says 'contract' although nothing is deployed and the difference is exactly 0; and the codehash only reproduces at /Users/naitik/surety/stylus. This entry is about the off-chain table only; it says nothing about an on-chain program.

summary: The Rust integer model and compiled WASM hold up under independent testing: 16,071 builder vectors and 31,530 of my own all match the TypeScript model, and an 80-digit Python reference agrees on every row; reverts are typed; there are no floats. Stylus is not deployed because activation is paused on the chain (activationGas = 2^64-1, confirmed on testnet and mainnet), so every on-chain check I was asked to do (cast calls, explorer page, verification) could not be done: deployments/stylus-pricer.json does not exist. Status is partial: the offline model is verified, nothing on chain is. Do not put an on-chain claim on /judge or in the docs. The checks were offline (WASM in Node with stubbed host calls) and read-only RPC calls; I sent no transactions.
finalCheckSummary: Final check: the off-chain Rust-pricer card now says 'the program's rounding' on both /agent pages (the 'contract's rounding' default remains only in the card that needs a deployment, which does not exist), and the Stylus statements in README, SECURITY, TECHNICAL and SUBMISSION make no on-chain claim. activationGas() re-read as 2^64-1 on testnet and mainnet; deployments/stylus-pricer.json still does not exist. Status unchanged: the Rust model is verified, nothing is verified on chain.
